after.text: An Assignment is one specific allocation to an agent. A permitted technical retry/fallback that actually redispatches the work creates a new Assignment and a new Attempt within the same Step Run, even if it reuses the recipient Session. The new allocation records its predecessor; an issued allocation is not silently rebound to a fallback Session. Code-only Attempts need not create Assignments.

conceptDefinitionChanges.before: A specific allocation of work to an agent, identifying the task, context, criteria and selected configuration. A Session can receive several Assignments; assignment alone proves neither execution nor satisfaction of the requirements.
conceptDefinitionChanges.after: A specific allocation of work to an agent with identified task, context, criteria, selected configuration and authority, distinct from proof of execution or satisfaction. It can span several Turns; each permitted retry or fallback that redispatches the work creates a new Assignment even if the same Session is reused.
